metadata.description: Constraint-driven planning and implementation plugins for GitHub Copilot and Claude Code

plugins.name: constraint-design
plugins.description: Plan-before-code bundle: project intake for new projects, CodeGraph-assisted project archaeology for existing codebases, relentless brainstorming, spec writing, and deep-module implementation planning.

plugins.name: constraint-dev
plugins.description: Disciplined implementation bundle: strict TDD, subagent-driven plan execution with per-task reviews, session ledger, and code review discipline.

plugins.name: umn-compliance
plugins.description: University of Minnesota compliance bundle: security compliance analysis and annual reviews against the 16 UMN Information Security Policy Standards. Org-specific.
